priorities.finding: Request-context features are the only screened group with positive primary lift. The lift is positive on all four days, though variability is material; within-user ranking evidence is stronger in GAUC (0.654 for cold users and 0.631 for warm users) than in nDCG@5 (0.492 and 0.508), indicating useful discrimination but limited top-five concentration.
priorities.recommended_action: Prioritize request_context for the next budgeted experiment, with a cautious allocation and mandatory post-score segment diagnostics. Do not expand the candidate set unless a stronger, temporally valid signal appears.

avoid: Current-impression outcome features are forbidden because they are unavailable at ranking time.
Aggregate snapshot features are quarantined because per-impression availability timestamps are missing.
metric_diagnosis: Screening is complete on a training-only internal temporal holdout. Request_context shows positive but modest primary lift and positive daily movement, while its GAUC results support within-user ordering more than its nDCG@5 results support top-five quality. The cold-item segment has only 8 rows and is non-informative at GAUC 0.5, so it should not drive a stop or launch decision. No weakest-segment evidence or latest experiment is available; therefore apply strict early stopping to all rejected groups and require post-score segment diagnostics before further spend.
